settings.serverUrlListHint: Add multiple URLs; if the primary goes offline, the backup takes over

settings.disallowEmptyUaHint: Block live requests with no User-Agent (VLC/scraper protection). Off by default.
settings.autoKickAfterHoursHint: Auto-drop a line open longer than N hours (0 = off).
settings.floodLimitPerMinHint: Max new stream requests one IP may open per minute (0 = off).
settings.cEngineHint: Settings below are engine-side; they take effect with the streaming-engine update (Roadmap I/L).
settings.maxLoginAttemptsHint: Consecutive failed-login threshold; IP is temporarily locked when exceeded.
settings.loginLockoutMinsHint: When the threshold is hit, the IP stays locked this many minutes.
settings.logoutOnIpChangeHint: Log out when the session IP changes (coming soon).
settings.resellerAllowChangeDnsHint: Resellers may change a line's server URL.
settings.resellerAllowChangeUsernameHint: Resellers may change an existing line's username.
settings.resellerAllowChangeEmailHint: Resellers may change a customer's email address.
settings.idleSleepHint: Stops the FFmpeg process of TRANSCODE streams that have no viewers (saves CPU/RAM). The stream auto-wakes when a viewer reconnects. Only TRANSCODE streams are affected; PROXY streams are untouched.
settings.idleSleepMinsHint: How many minutes at 0 viewers before the stream is put to sleep.
settings.geoWarning: ⚠ This setting only affects the admin panel. Be sure to add your own country to the list; otherwise you will lock yourself out of the panel!
settings.geoBlockEnabledHint: Allow admin panel access only from permitted countries
settings.realIpModeHint: If the panel is behind Cloudflare/proxy, to get the real visitor IP. A wrong setting breaks connection limits and geo-block. Direct nginx: auto.
settings.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app:
settings.minCreditWarningHint: Warn when it falls below this value
settings.tierMultiplierDesc: The credit amount deducted per transaction is multiplied by the reseller's tier. 1 = standard, 2 = 2x credits.
settings.creditPricingDesc: Defines how many credits are deducted for each duration when resellers create/extend users. The tier multiplier is applied on top of these values.
settings.customPricingActiveHint: Calculated per day for durations not in the list
settings.backupEncryptionHint: If set, backups are encrypted with AES-256 (.enc). Empty = plain .gz. Keep this key safe — required for restore.
settings.savedRefresh: Saved. (Refresh the browser for new addresses.)
settings.aiDesc: Generates AI reply drafts for support requests. Dormant until you enter and enable an LLM API key; the key is stored on the server only.
settings.aiModelHint: Default if empty (claude-haiku-4-5 / gpt-4o-mini). E.g. claude-sonnet-5
settings.panelHostsDesc: Serve the reseller and client panels on a hostname separate from the MAIN panel address — so resellers/customers never see the admin address. When opened from the hostname you set here, the SPA shows only the relevant panel. Also requires DNS (A record) + nginx server block + SSL (setup step). If left empty, path-based (/reseller, /client) keeps working.
settings.currencyHint: Currency used to display prices across the panel.

tools.probeDurNone: No VOD with missing duration — all already filled.
tools.sanitizeDesc: Finds streams whose name has leaked EXTINF attributes (tvg-logo/group-title) from the old parser bug and fixes them to the real name. For SERIES it reduces to the series title. Preview first.
